name: What an author does with a cited thinker at a passage

values.gloss: the thinker is invoked to license a claim; the passage rests on the name
the thinker's finding or text is used as evidence for a claim of the author's
the thinker's position is set up to be argued against or corrected
the author reasons with the thinker, weighing the position without adopting or rejecting it
the thinker is placed as an origin or a stage in a lineage of ideas
the thinker supplies an example that illustrates a point made independently
a mention owed to the field or to the reader, not load-bearing
the author locates their own work relative to the thinker
